Veterans Benefits: Beginning tax year 2026 Georgia exempts up to $65,000 of military retirement pay regardless of age. Georgia also provides a disabled-veteran homestead property-tax exemption for qualifying 100% service-connected disabled veterans and eligible survivors, with the amount adjusted annually.

Description: Warner Robins is a Middle Georgia city built around Robins Air Force Base and the Warner Robins Air Logistics Complex, a major Air Force sustainment hub. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, affordable housing, Georgia's expanded military-retirement tax exclusion, and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include a county-level crime rate in the moderate range, hot humid summers, and no local Costco yet (a Macon-area warehouse is planned for 2027).
